faqs.question: Is 🫤❓ dead?
faqs.answer: 🫤❓ is not dead. Sarcasm-coded emoji combos are stable across short-form video and chat; the register ages well.

faqs.question: How do I make sarcasm land clearly with 🫤❓?
faqs.answer: Pair 🫤❓ with a clear lead-up that sets the joke. Sarcasm-coded emojis work best when the surrounding message makes the irony obvious.

faqs.question: Does 🫤❓ work in family groups?
faqs.answer: In family groups 🫤❓ works best when the family already uses sarcasm as love-coded banter. Otherwise it tends to misread.

faqs.question: Does 🫤❓ mean what it says?
faqs.answer: No — 🫤❓ rarely means the literal reading. The sarcasm cue is the whole point: the sender is signaling that you should take the message sideways.
